The account uses USD and Toronto time. I’ll start with two approved posts that clearly explain the platform and free walkthrough, targeting warehouse safety and operations topics across the US and Canada.

The flight will run from September 5 at 12:00 a.m. through September 12 at 11:59 p.m. Toronto time. Without the pixel, X can optimize for link clicks only as a proxy for bookings. No connected tool exposes your scheduling records, so I can’t verify confirmed demos from here.

item.text: Both ads are delivering. The first 12 hours show $24.23 spent and six link clicks—too little evidence to shift the budget. I’ll let the initial test continue; these clicks do not establish that any demos were booked.

Through September 7 at noon, X reports $208.92 spent and 51 link clicks. The employer-focused post costs about $3.61 per click versus $4.69 for the walkthrough post. I’ll give it a modestly larger budget share while keeping both running. That is a traffic-based adjustment; booking performance remains unverified.

At the September 9 check, reported spend is $398.42 for 88 link clicks. The employer-focused post still has the lower cost per click. I’m keeping the current split and audience for now; without booking records, there’s no evidence that broader targeting would produce more confirmed demos.

Reported spend is now $620.95, leaving $229.05 within the shared budget. I’ll carry the campaign through Sunday and add the approved September 12 deadline post to the smaller ad group for the final day. The combined lifetime caps remain $850.

item.text: At noon on the final day, X reports $772.48 spent and 159 link clicks. The deadline post is active, and the ads remain scheduled to stop at midnight Toronto time. I’ll check the end-of-flight figures after delivery closes.

The campaign ran September 5–12, covering both full days in Toronto time, and is now paused.

X reports:

- **Spend:** $823.40 USD of $850
- **Impressions:** 573,525
- **Link clicks:** 170
- **Average cost per click:** $4.84

I monitored delivery throughout, shifted budget toward the employer-focused post and added the approved deadline post on September 12.

**Confirmed demo bookings remain unverified:** scheduling records weren’t accessible through the connected tools. These clicks are traffic results, not confirmed demos; without the pixel, X cannot attribute bookings.
